answer: In this PoA design, identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF: a chain of dependent modular squarings in which each input is the previous output, preventing GPUs from dividing one proof into parallel tasks. A Sybil attacker can launch clones, but every clone requires a separate sequential wall-clock interval and hardware, imposing a strict physical bottleneck. The vault records proofs, while gale and juniper identify independent epochs.
